options.text: They locked the map in a car.
They looked many times in the car.
It cost a lot of money when the car leaked oil.
They didn't have enough money to buy another car.

questions.explanation: 'lacked the money' = didn't have enough money. 'locked', 'looked', 'cost' hanya bunyinya mirip.
hints: Fokus ke baris kedua. Cari sinonim kata kuncinya, dan hindari opsi yang bunyinya mirip kata di audio.
Kata kunci baris kedua: lacked the money.
Jawaban D. 'lacked the money' = didn't have enough money. 'locked', 'looked', 'cost' hanya bunyinya mirip.

script: Did they get the new car they wanted?

options.text: It's important to pack the suitcases.
They need help carrying their bags.
The man should pack his suit in case he needs it.
The suitcases are quite portable.

questions.explanation: 'call the porter to get the suitcases' = butuh bantuan membawa tas.
hints: Fokus ke baris kedua. Cari sinonim kata kuncinya, dan hindari opsi yang bunyinya mirip kata di audio.
Apa tugas seorang porter?
Jawaban B. 'call the porter to get the suitcases' = butuh bantuan membawa tas.

script: You should call the porter to get the suitcases.

options.text: A newspaper editor.
A police officer.
A teacher.
A student.

questions.explanation: Ia menyebut 'homework assignment' dan 'quiz' dari 'your class', jadi ia guru.
hints: Cari petunjuk (kata kunci) yang menunjukkan siapa, apa, atau di mana.
Kata 'your class' menunjukkan siapa?
Jawaban C. Ia menyebut 'homework assignment' dan 'quiz' dari 'your class', jadi ia guru.

script: Can you tell me what assignments I missed when I was absent from your class?
You missed one homework assignment and a quiz.

questions.text: What will the man probably do next?

options.text: Sit down in the library.
Look for some more books.
Return the books to the shelves.
Go to the circulation desk.

questions.explanation: Ia mau 'check them out now' (meminjam), dan meminjam dilakukan di circulation desk.
hints: Cari petunjuk (kata kunci) yang menunjukkan siapa, apa, atau di mana.
Di mana buku dipinjam?
Jawaban D. Ia mau 'check them out now' (meminjam), dan meminjam dilakukan di circulation desk.

script: Are you going to read those books here in the library?
I think I'd rather check them out now and take them home.
What will the man probably do next?

questions.text: Where does this conversation probably take place?

options.text: At a beauty salon.
At the beach.
In a sandbox.
At an outdoor restaurant.

hints: Cari petunjuk (kata kunci) yang menunjukkan siapa, apa, atau di mana.
Garis bawah: water, sand, suntan lotion.
Jawaban B. Petunjuk: water, sand, suntan lotion.

script: Are you going into the water, or are you just going to lie there on the sand?
I think I need to put on some suntan lotion.
Where does this conversation probably take place?

options.text: She's not completely sure when they are leaving.
They are returning from the city at about 4:00.
She knows when they are leaving.
She doesn't have any idea when they are leaving.

hints: Dengarkan ungkapan setuju, ragu/saran, atau terkejut di baris kedua.
Perhatikan tag question di akhir.
Jawaban A. Tag question 'don't they?' menandakan ketidakpastian.

script: Do you know what time they're leaving for the city?
They have to leave at four o'clock, don't they?

options.text: They should stop drinking.
They should go for a walk.
They should walk thirty miles.
They should take a break and have a drink.

questions.explanation: 'Let's stop and get a drink' adalah saran.
hints: Dengarkan ungkapan setuju, ragu/saran, atau terkejut di baris kedua.
'Let's ...' itu saran.
Jawaban D. 'Let's stop and get a drink' adalah saran.

script: I'm so thirsty from all this walking.
Let's stop and get a drink.

options.text: He thinks the building was not renovated.
He has the same opinion of the building as the woman.
He doesn't care about the renovation of the building.
He suggests being careful in the renovated building.

questions.explanation: 'I don't either' = setuju dengan pernyataan negatif.
hints: Dengarkan ungkapan setuju, ragu/saran, atau terkejut di baris kedua.
'I don't either' adalah ungkapan setuju.
Jawaban B. 'I don't either' = setuju dengan pernyataan negatif.

script: I don't really care for the way the building was renovated.

options.text: She agrees with the man.
She thinks he should become county supervisor.
She thinks the candidates are qualified.
She has no opinion about the candidates for county supervisor.

hints: Dengarkan ungkapan setuju, ragu/saran, atau terkejut di baris kedua.
'Me, too' itu setuju atau tidak?
Jawaban A. 'Me, too' menyatakan setuju.

script: I think that both candidates for county supervisor are unqualified.

options.text: The woman was a good skier.
The woman was going skiing this weekend.
The woman did not know how to ski.
The woman did not intend to go skiing.

questions.explanation: 'So you CAN ski!' (kejutan) berarti sebelumnya ia mengira wanita itu tidak bisa bermain ski.
hints: Dengarkan ungkapan setuju, ragu/saran, atau terkejut di baris kedua.
Kata 'can' ditekankan. Apa dugaannya sebelumnya?
Jawaban C. 'So you CAN ski!' (kejutan) berarti sebelumnya ia mengira wanita itu tidak bisa bermain ski.

script: Would you like to go skiing this weekend?

questions.text: What does the man need to do?

options.text: Reapply for his driver's license.
Sweep around the lawn.
Learn the laws for the first time.
Review the information that will be on the test.

hints: Idiom tidak bermakna harfiah. Cari makna kiasan, bukan arti kata per kata.
'brush up on' bukan menyapu.
Jawaban D. 'brush up on' = mengulang/menyegarkan pengetahuan.

script: I need to take the written test to renew my driver's license.
Then, you'll have to brush up on the laws.
What does the man need to do?

options.text: The president dropped his pen.
The audience was very quiet.
The speech contained several puns.
The president discussed dropping a bomb.

questions.explanation: 'You could hear a pin drop' = sangat sunyi.
hints: Idiom tidak bermakna harfiah. Cari makna kiasan, bukan arti kata per kata.
Ungkapan kiasan tentang suasana.
Jawaban B. 'You could hear a pin drop' = sangat sunyi.

script: What was it like while the president was giving his speech?
You could hear a pin drop.
